week_quote: Little moments held with care become big memories.

sections.title: Light Within
sections.tagline: Every calm breath feeds the light inside.
body: Sit in a circle. Imagine a gentle golden light glowing in your chest. Let it grow with every breath.
sections.note: Let the light grow gently - it prefers soft guidance.

sections.title: The Family Values Line-Up
sections.tagline: True connection happens when movement reveals what words usually hide.
body: Form a circle around the oldest person. They choose one deeply reflective sentence from the list below or they create one themselves and finishes it honestly:

‘I feel most like myself when…’ One truth about me today is…’, ‘Something invisible but important in my life right now is…’ ‘A part of me I want to grow is…’ ‘A word that feels like home is…’ ‘A word that strengthens me is…’
As soon as the Starter finishes their sentence, each family member responds with movement:
Step closer to the center = strong connection to reflection Step one step back = gentle connection to reflection
Change the Starter by going anticlockwise.
For 2 people: Stand face to face. One shares the reflection, the other steps forward (strong connection) or back (gentle connection). Switch roles
sections.note: Step where it feels true, no choreography, no judging panel.

sections.title: Lesson of the Month
body: Each person completes the sentence: ‘This month, I learned…’ by sharing a personal discovery or something new they noticed about themselves or their family.
sections.note: Share your lesson honestly, life is the only teacher that doesn’t take holidays.

sections.title: Silent Snow-Globe
sections.tagline: A tiny pause to notice your breath, like snow settling in silence.
body: Imagine you are inside a calm snow globe. Watch “snow” fall in your mind for one minute.
sections.note: No shaking the imaginary snow-globe, please.

sections.title: Know-Me Switch
sections.tagline: A fast, playful way to learn surprising things about each other.
body: Stand together in a circle. The first Caller is the person whose birthday falls closest to the middle of the year.

Round 1 Color Challenge The Caller chooses a color and says, for example: ‘Everyone with RED on them- switch!’ Anyone wearing that color quickly and safely switches spots in the circle.Play a few rounds using different colors.
Round 2 Likes & Dislikes Go clockwise, the next Caller announces for example: ‘Everyone who loves warm drinks — switch!’

Round 3 Habits & Traits The next Caller chooses categories like: ‘Everyone who sees themselves as patient-switch!’ ‘Everyone who thinks they’re organized-switch!’ Play for as long as you enjoy it and feel free to invent your own categories.
sections.note: Quick swaps only, slow motion is for dramatic movies.

sections.title: I Am Sorry
sections.tagline: A sincere ‘sorry’ is the shortest bridge between two hearts
body: Sit together in a circle. The first person turns to the person sitting on their right side and simply says: ‘I am sorry for…’ followed by a real, recent example that they want to apologize for.
sections.note: Say it simply, apologies don’t need fireworks.

sections.title: Circle of Light
sections.tagline: May your family’s calm and kindness ripple far and wide. May every heart feel a spark of peace. Merry Christmas, in the most mindful way.
body: Sit together in silence, holding hands. As you breathe, imagine all your shared lights rising gently upward, forming a warm halo above your family. Stay in that glow for one minute. Visualize shared light expanding softly beyond your home, out into the world.
sections.note: Stay here a moment longer… it’s the heart of it all.

sections.title: Christmas Family Singing Moment
sections.tagline: Singing together is the purest form of celebration.
body: Stand or sit close together. Choose one favorite Christmas carol or winter song. The person wearing the most festive color begins singing the first line. Everyone joins in and sings the rest together as one family voice.
sections.note: Sing with heart! Perfection optional, joy required.

sections.title: Circle of Gratitude & Wishes
sections.tagline: May the warmth we’ve built this Advent keep glowing in our hearts.
body: Gratitude for This Advent
Each person says one thing they are grateful for that happened during this Advent. Something about your shared moments, feelings, or time together.
Wishes for Our Family
Each person says one heartfelt wish for your family for Christmas and the New Year.
sections.note: Make your wish with heart, Christmas Eve has excellent hearing, even for shy hopes.
